description: Opens a new comment thread on specific text in an ODocs.co document, without changing the document text. Suited to review: flagging a problem, asking a question, or suggesting a change for a person to decide on. The comment is anchored to `quote` (exact text from the document, matched like replace-text; occurrence selects one match when the quote appears more than once) and is shown highlighted in the editor. Returns the new thread, including its id, as JSON, with a note (that comments are written by anyone with the link) as a second text item.

author.description: Name shown on your edits and comments (e.g. "MyAgent"), with a robot mark as an agent. Invisible and text-direction characters are removed, line breaks and control characters become spaces, and it is cut to 256 characters. A name that resembles ODocs.co or Octaria (including look-alike spellings) is shown as "Agent (Anonymous)". When any of that happens the result has a `warning` field saying what changed.

occurrence.description: 0-based index of the match (the earliest match is 0); required when the quote appears more than once. It counts every match in the whole doc text, including the phrase inside longer lines; approximateLineNumber and the context in the result show which match was used.

quote.description: Exact text in the document to comment on, matched exactly against the current text, like replace-text.

name: create-comment
title: Create Comment
